messages:
deploy-bot: 🚀 Fanout deploy started for prod
deploy-bot: services=[runtime@v2.3.1 api@v5.8.0 console@v1.12.0] commit_tags={runtime:abc1234, api:def5678, console:ghi9012} change_window=22:00-02:00 UTC canary=10% for runtime
zach: ack. watching metrics and traces. canary config looks good.
maria: :eyes: seeing a spike in runtime 5xxs in the canary pods (2 errors/s -> 15 errors/s) right after cold-start
devon: can you paste a small log snippet? I want to check stack trace.
maria: log snippet:
```
2026-03-19T22:12:04Z runtime[abc1234]: panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
goroutine 1024 [running]:
main.handleRequest(0xc000...)
```
ashley_pm: ugh. this is during the change window but we need to avoid user impact. proposal: pause runtime fanout, pin runtime back to v2.3.0, let api+console finish. then triage runtime with a rollback patch.
sam_ops: running pin now: `/deploy pin runtime v2.3.0 --reason "canary 5xx spike" --by sam_ops`
deploy-bot: runtime pinned to v2.3.0 by sam_ops. Pausing runtime fanout and routing new runtime traffic to fallback pool (v2.3.0). Canary traffic for runtime stopped.
jen_sre: noted. marking incident tag `runtime-canary-5xx` and notifying on-call. creating a short postmortem stub.
zach: api and console are still in flight — ok to let them finish. if they finish green we can cut release notes for those and ship.
maria: confirm: we should still capture KV cache warmup behaviour; the panic seems related to LRU cache path.
devon: initial read: NPE from cache on concurrent eviction. I think v2.3.1 introduced a non-atomic map ref. will prepare a revert PR.
ashley_pm: agree. please include regression test for concurrent cache ops before re-promote.
sam_ops: deploybot update: api -> SUCCESS (api@v5.8.0 def5678), console -> SUCCESS (console@v1.12.0 ghi9012)
ashley_pm: good. runtime is serving from pinned v2.3.0 for prod; we will not roll forward until patch lands and passes canary.
zach: :thumbsup: can we schedule a 30m post-deploy triage at 23:00 UTC to review metrics and next steps?
jen_sre: scheduled 23:00 UTC in #incidents, invite sent.
maria: grabbing traces and flamegraphs, will drop links in the triage thread.
devon: opened PR #4821 `runtime: fix concurrent cache eviction NPE` with tests. tagging for review.
ashley_pm: awesome. once PR merged we can do a controlled canary (5% -> 25% -> 50%) and watch for the 5xxs.
deploy-bot: final statuses: runtime=PINNED(v2.3.0, pinned_by=sam_ops, commit=abc1220), api=DEPLOYED(v5.8.0, commit=def5678), console=DEPLOYED(v1.12.0, commit=ghi9012)
deploy-bot: change_window still active until 02:00 UTC. rollback option available: `/deploy rollback runtime v2.3.0` (disabled since pinned)
ashley_pm: logging this in the release notes: runtime rolled back to v2.3.0 due to canary 5xx regression; api and console released as planned. follow-up: postmortem + regression test required before next runtime promote.
zach: thanks all. good catch on canary. :eyes:
